entry_sequence.transcript_quote: locate the first 15-minutes candle that formed on today's date
entry_sequence.action: Identify the first 15-minute candle of the trading day and draw a range line at its high and low.
entry_sequence.rationale: This establishes the structural box for the manipulation candle.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: confirm that the candle you just boxed is what I call a manipulation candle
entry_sequence.action: Confirm the 15-minute candle is a manipulation candle by checking if its range is 20 to 25% or more of the Daily ATR.
entry_sequence.rationale: The ATR threshold confirms the move was aggressive enough to be institutional.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for one of two specific reversal candles to appear outside the range you boxed in step one
entry_sequence.action: Wait for a reversal candle (Hammer, Inverted Hammer, Bullish Engulfing, or Bearish Engulfing) to appear outside the 15m range.
entry_sequence.rationale: The reversal candle signals the start of the intended move against the manipulation.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: wait for the next candle to break above the hammer high, enter at the open of the candle after that
entry_sequence.action: Enter long on the open of the candle following the break above the reversal candle's high.
entry_sequence.rationale: The break confirms the reversal intent and provides a high-probability entry.

entry_sequence.transcript_quote: enter at the low of the engulfing candle
entry_sequence.action: Enter long on a limit order at the high of the previous red candle (for bullish engulfing).
entry_sequence.rationale: The engulfing candle provides a high-probability entry at a key reversal level.

stop.transcript_quote: set your stop at the low of the hammer
stop.rationale: The stop is placed beyond the low of the reversal candle wick.

targets.transcript_quote: target profit? The top of the range we drew in step one.
targets.rationale: The top of the 15m range serves as the primary profit target.

targets.transcript_quote: target profit at the top of the box.
targets.rationale: The bottom of the 15m range serves as the primary profit target for short setups.

speaker_concepts.verbatim_description: The first 15-minutes candle that formed on today's date. Simply draw a line at the high and low of that candle and extend both lines in the future for the next 60 to 90 minutes.
A fast, aggressive move either up or down. Direction doesn't matter. What matters is that it's fast. It's aggressive, and it's moving in one direction.

A line drawn at the high and low of the first 15-minutes candle and extended for the next 60 to 90 minutes. The box actually serves double-duty here. It gives us the entry zone on one side and two natural profit targets on the other.
This gives you a number. That value represents the average daily range over the past 14 days.
If the size of the candle you just boxed from high to low is 20 to 25% or more of that daily ATR, it's a confirmed manipulation candle.
This needs to appear after a clear sharp red move downward. That long lower wick, that's not random. It's telling you that a massive buyer stepped in and absorbed all that selling pressure.
It appears after a clear green move upward with the wick extending from the top. It works the same way in reverse.
A bullish engulfing fully swallow[s] the previous red candle. I like to set my entry limit order at the high of that previous red candle.
A bearish engulfing works the mirror way. Entry at the low of the previous green candle, stop at the high of the engulfing candle.
A moving average line running through the volume histogram, which is set with an MA period of 20.
A high volume event that tells you that big players were actively involved in creating that move.
The quality of a move, indicating that the move may not be sustainable if it lacks this footprint.
Used to qualify if the candle is big enough to be considered for the setup.
